title_zh: 京张开源脉冲八项运维行动包
author: 许丙南
boundary_note: These are accountable work packages for review and future refinement, not approved projects, budgets, procurement or government commitments.

packages.public_objective: Replace provisional constraints with official polygons and disclose what remains unknown.
packages.acceptance_test: Every spatial claim links to a geometry version, source, formula and limitation.
packages.stop_condition: No official or cleared source, or unresolved ownership/safety boundary.
packages.maintenance: Version and re-run all dependent layers after every geometry change.

packages.name_zh: 无障碍与人类体验基线
packages.public_objective: Measure step-free continuity, shade, rest, night access and no-app service before any AI window.
packages.acceptance_test: A representative route is usable and reportable without an account or device.
packages.stop_condition: Unresolved route break, unsafe test or group difference hidden by an average.
packages.maintenance: Repeat after seasonal or spatial change; retain aggregate results only.

packages.public_objective: Turn cang-feng, shade and sponge-city language into separable engineering checks.
packages.responsible: conceptual: climate and municipal engineering team
packages.acceptance_test: All six wind-water-health gates have inputs, calibration, responsibility and stop rules.
packages.stop_condition: Missing geometry alignment, calibration, source schedule, detection limit or safe field condition.
packages.maintenance: Recalibrate after major building, tree, pavement or drainage change.

packages.name_zh: 具身智能封闭到公开窗口
packages.public_objective: Prove emergency stop, human takeover, offline fallback, rights and return to ordinary use.
packages.acceptance_test: One booked window ends with a signed test-window record, no blocked accessible route and a tested manual equivalent.
packages.stop_condition: Serious conflict, failed stop/takeover, rights breach or loss of public route.
packages.maintenance: Daily bay check during a window; freeze after overdue inspection or unavailable spare.

packages.public_objective: Make contribution, attribution, withdrawal and plain-language explanation visible.
packages.acceptance_test: A contributor can understand, correct or withdraw a display without a digital account.
packages.stop_condition: Unclear source, consent, attribution or complaint route.
packages.maintenance: Monthly rights audit and 48-hour removal/replacement for invalid material.

packages.name_zh: 大钟寺活动降容与复原
packages.public_objective: Let international events coexist with ordinary resident return, fire safety, quiet and rain conveyance.
packages.acceptance_test: Capacity can drop to zero while the resident route stays open and the space returns to daily use.
packages.stop_condition: Fire, noise, crowd, water or resident-access threshold breach.
packages.maintenance: Pre-event inspection; post-event cleanup and defect work order.

packages.name_zh: 雨洪树池与夜间安静链
packages.public_objective: Keep passive drainage, rest, low-glare guidance and manual inspection reliable.
packages.acceptance_test: Rainwater inlet, accessible seat and quiet route remain usable under a sensor/network failure.
packages.stop_condition: Overdue inlet, unsafe water depth, excessive glare/noise or missing asset owner.
packages.maintenance: 24-hour pre-rain check, 48-hour post-rain closure, nightly quiet-chain check.

packages.name_zh: 年度证据复盘与扩散/退出
packages.spatial_anchor: all key areas and regional return loop
packages.public_objective: Publish evidence, compare groups and climate states, then scale, redesign or remove.
packages.acceptance_test: Every active scenario has a public state, known limits, next gate and an explicit expand/redesign/retire decision.
packages.stop_condition: Evidence cannot be reproduced, rights ledger incomplete or unresolved public harm.
packages.maintenance: Seasonal review plus annual archive and schema migration check.
